correctness.rationale: Conditional on Higashitani–Ueyama arXiv:2610.05311v1 Theorem 5.16 classification input (the tetrahedron condition at every 4-set and exclusion of the single 7-face octahedral orbit), the finite derivation is exhaustive. Represent each of 20 possible triples by a bit; every one of 2^20=1,048,576 masks checked against all 15 four-set 3-face exclusions yields 50,334 eligible. All 720 S6 relabelings of obstruction yield exactly 120 distinct eligible masks; subtract to get 50,214. Independent complete orbit partition gives 174 orbits with orbit-size weighted sum 50,214, and exact polynomial coefficients 1,20,190,1080,3885,8844,12510,10800,6870,3540,1568,440,330,60,60,0,15,0,0,0,1 in degrees 0..20. Own completely independent mask scan and orbit partition confirms ALL values. The original nonstandard classification theorem itself is a cited external mathematical premise, not independently reproved; its full text was inaccessible this run and this limitation is material.
